eval_cases.prompt: How does the Google Agents CLI Extension System work and how does it support LangChain and LangGraph?
eval_cases.reference: The Agents CLI Extension System uses agents-cli-extension.yaml to override framework-coupled commands (run, playground, eval.generate, publish.gemini-enterprise) and add custom commands while preserving 18+ framework-agnostic commands like deploy and eval grade. It sets AGENTS_CLI_DISABLE_OVERRIDES=1 to allow safe delegation without recursion.

eval_cases.prompt: Compare single-pass RAG with iterative Agentic Self-Reflection workflows and cite foundational papers.
eval_cases.reference: Single-pass RAG retrieves top-k passages once (Lewis et al., ARXIV-2005.11401), whereas iterative Agentic Self-Reflection workflows (ReAct ARXIV-2210.03629, Reflexion ARXIV-2303.11366, Self-RAG ARXIV-2310.11511) plan sub-queries, critique intermediate evidence, and revise before synthesizing a final cited report.
